cohort: The participants were late second trimester (26-27 weeks) and early third trimester (28-30 weeks) pregnant women checking their pregnancy at referral hospitals.
finding: Six variables (method of childbirth, prolonged labour, postpartum hemorrhage, repeated vaginal examination, episiostomy, and choice of childbirth position) significantly influenced the RMC score, explaining 44.1% of its variance.
mod_finding: Medical interventions, specifically cesarean delivery and episiostomy, were found to negatively affect RMC scores.
cross-section timing: Late second trimester (26-27 weeks) and early third trimester (28-30 weeks) of pregnancy
